title: A morphism of invertible modules nonzero on every residue fibre is invertible
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let P,Q be invertible O_X-modules [def-sc-invertible-module] and beta:P -> Q a module morphism. If pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] of beta along Spec kappa(x) -> X is nonzero for every point x of X, then beta is an isomorphism.

proof.text: The existing Lean proof chooses a common affine neighbourhood on which P and Q have free generators. Write beta as multiplication by b. If b vanishes at x, its image in kappa(x) is zero, so the residue-field pullback of beta is zero, contradicting the hypothesis. Hence x lies in D(b). On every open inside D(b), restriction of b is a unit, so multiplication by it, and therefore beta on sections, is bijective. The local sectionwise bijectivity criterion proves IsIso beta. For an empty scheme the local criterion is vacuous; no nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.
